title: Architecting the Corporate AI Infrastructure: The Evolving Roles of AI Governance Committees and Chief Ethics Officers
abstract: arXiv:2611.19670v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The accelerating integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into core business operations has created an urgent need for robust corporate governance infrastructures capable of managing complex ethical, legal, and operational risks. While organizations have increasingly adopted high-level AI ethics principles, a critical implementation gap persists: fewer than half of organizations that cite AI governance as a boardroom priority have a formalized governance framework in place. translated_title: 构建企业AI基础设施：AI治理委员会与首席道德官角色的演进
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）加速融入企业核心业务运营，对能够管理复杂伦理、法律和运营风险的健全企业治理基础设施产生了迫切需求。尽管各组织日益采纳高层次的AI伦理原则，但仍存在一个关键的实施差距：在将AI治理列为董事会优先事项的组织中，不到一半拥有正式的治理框架。本文通过提出一个以两个相互强化的支柱为中心的结构化企业AI治理架构（CAIGA）来弥合这一差距。第一，本文考察了专门的C级高管角色——特别是首席隐私官（CPO）和首席道德官（ChEO）——在企业范围内将AI使用责任制形式化的不断演变的职责。第二，本文认为跨职能的AI治理委员会，通过联合来自法律、技术等领域（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出结构化企业AI治理架构（CAIGA），以C级高管角色（首席隐私官与首席道德官）和跨职能AI治理委员会为两大相互强化的支柱，弥合AI伦理原则与实际治理实施之间的关键差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structured Corporate AI Governance Architecture (CAIGA) built on two mutually reinforcing pillars—specialized C-suite roles (CPOs and Chief Ethics Officers) and cross-functional AI Governance Committees—to bridge the critical implementation gap between high-level AI ethics principles and formalized governance frameworks.
